q: Choose the correct narration- Rimu said to her mother, "I shall go to bed now."
o: Rimu told her mother that she would go to bed then.
Rimu told her mother that she should go to bed now.
Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed now.
Rimu told her mother that she will go to bed then.

q: Tomy said to me, “What do you know about the issue?”
o: Tomy said to me what I know about the issue.
Tomy asked me what I did knew about the issue?
Tomy asked me what did I know about the issue?
Tomy asked me what I knew about the issue.

q: Change into indirect narration: He said to me, "Where do you live?"
o: He ask me where I live.
He said to me where he lived.
He asked to me where I lived.
He asked me where I lived.
e: Direct বাক্যটি একটি প্রশ্ন, তাই indirect speech-এ said to বদলে asked বসে। প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যের wh-শব্দ (এখানে where) যুক্তকারী হিসেবে থেকে যায় এবং এর পরের অংশ সাধারণ বাক্যের ক্রমে লেখা হয়, অর্থাৎ do/does আর থাকে না। reporting verb past হওয়ায় do live হয়ে যায় lived, আর pronoun you বদলে I হয়। তাই সঠিক রূপ He asked me where I lived। অন্য বিকল্পে said বা ask-এর ব্যবহার এবং asked to me গঠন ভুল।

q: Change the narration: Alam said to me 'Let us go out for a walk.' (Make it indirect)
o: Alam proposed to me that we should go out for a walk.
Alam suggested me to we go out for a walk.
Alam proposed to me that we should have gone for a walk.
Alam asked me to go out for a walk.
e: Let us দিয়ে শুরু হওয়া প্রস্তাবমূলক বাক্যের indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে propose বা suggest হয়। Quotation চিহ্ন সরে that আসে, তারপর we should এবং মূল verb থেকে বাক্যের বাকি অংশ বসে। বক্তা Alam ও শ্রোতা "me" মিলে "us", তাই we ব্যবহার করা ঠিক। সঠিক রূপ: Alam proposed to me that we should go out for a walk. Asked ব্যবহার করলে প্রস্তাবের ভাব হারিয়ে যায়, আর should have gone অতীতের অর্থ নিয়ে আসে যা এখানে অপ্রযোজ্য।

q: He requested me to clarify the matter. (Make it direct)
o: He said to me, “Please, clarify the matter”.
He said to me, “You will clarify the matter”.
He said to me, “Will you clarify the matter?”
He said to me, “You clarify the matter”.

q: Choose the correct indirect speech of: The girl said, "Alas! I am undone."
o: The girl exclaimed with disgust that she was undone.
The girl said that she was undone.
The girl exclaimed with sorrow that she was undone.
The girl exclaim that she was undone.
e: Direct speech-এ Alas! শব্দটি দুঃখ প্রকাশ করে, তাই exclamatory sentence-এর indirect-এ reporting verb হয় exclaimed with sorrow (বা with grief)। এরপর that বসে এবং reported অংশ যথাক্রমে সাজে: The girl exclaimed with sorrow that she was undone. আনন্দের ভাব হলে with joy বসত। With disgust অর্থ ঘৃণা, যা এখানে অপ্রাসঙ্গিক; আর exclaim (বর্তমান রূপ) past বাক্যে বেমানান।

q: He has said to me, “What a lame excuse you have presented!” (Indirect)
o: He has exclaimed with disgust that I have presented a very lame excuse.
He said to me what a lame excuse I have presented.
He has told me what a lame excuse I had presented.
He has exclaimed with disgust that I had presented a very lame excuse.

q: My brother said to me, "You had better stay home." [indirect]
o: My brother advised me to stay home.
My brother ordered me that I had better stay home
My brother proposed me to stay home.
My brother advised that I stayed home.

q: Which one is a correct change of narration? He said to me, “Let me stay alone.”
o: He suggested to me that he should stay alone
He told me that he should stay alone
He requested me to let him stay alone
He proposed to me that he might stay alone
e: “Let me stay alone” একটি অনুরোধ, কারণ বক্তা শ্রোতার কাছে একা থাকতে দেওয়ার অনুমতি চাইছে। তাই indirect-এ requested + object + to let him ... বসে। সঠিক রূপ: He requested me to let him stay alone। Suggested বা proposed প্রস্তাবের ভাব আনে, আর told that he should বাধ্যবাধকতা বোঝায়; এগুলো মূল অর্থের সাথে মেলে না।

q: Rupa said, "I must finish my homework." (Make it indirect)
o: Rupa said that she must finished her homework.
Rupa said that she had to be finished her homework.
Rupa said that she had to finish her homework.
Rupa said that she has to finish her homework.

q: He said to me, “What a fool you are!”. (Make it indirect)
o: He exclaimed with wonder that I am a great fool.
He exclaimed with wonder what a great fool I am.
He exclaimed with wonder what a fool I am.
He exclaimed with wonder that I was a great fool.

q: Munna said to Zahin, "I shall come to you tomorrow." (Make it indirect)
o: Munna told Zahin that he will come to him the next day.
Munna told Zahin that he would go to him the following day.
Munna told Zahin that he would come to him tomorrow.
Munna said to Zahin that he would go to him tomorrow.

q: I said to her, "Friend, help me." (Indirect)
o: Addressing her friend, I asked her to help me.
Addressing her as a friend, I requested her to help me.
I requested her to help me.
I asked her for help.

q: The headmaster says, “The inspector will visit our school at 11 am today.”
o: The Headmaster says that the Inspector will visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that the inspector will visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that the inspector is being visit their school at 11 am today
The Headmaster said that today at 11 am the inspector must visit their school
e: Reporting verb present (says) হলে reported speech-এর tense বদলায় না, শুধু person বদলায়। তাই will visit থাকে, আর our হয় their। Today-ও একই দিনের কথা বলায় বদলায় না। সঠিক রূপ: The Headmaster says that the Inspector will visit their school at 11 am today। Said বসালে reporting verb বদলে যায়, ‘is being visit’ গঠনগত ভুল, আর must অর্থ বদলে দেয়।

q: Himu says, I have done my duty.” (make it indirect)
o: Himu says that he had done his duty.
Himu says that he has done his duty.
Himu tells that he had done his duty.
Himu tells that he has done his duty.

q: Rahim said, "I must finish the work today." (make it indirect)
o: Rahim said that he has to finish the work today.
Rahim said that he must finish the work today.
Rahim said that he finished the work that day.
Rahim said that he had to finish the work that day.

q: The girl told him, ''Please be careful.'' (Make it indirect)
o: The girl asked him not to be careless.
The girl told him to be careful.
The girl advised him to take care.
The girl requested to be careful by him.

q: Rajib said to me, "Let us go to the party together."
o: Rajib proposed to me to go to the party together.
Rajib urged to me that to go to the party together.
Rajib asked to me that we should go to the party together.
Rajib proposed to me that we should go to the party together.

q: Change the Narration: My friend said to me, "May you pass the pen to her."
o: My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her.
My friend hoped that I might pass the pen to her.
My friend prayed me I might pass the pen to her.
My friend wished me I might pass the pen to her.
e: Optative বাক্যে (May...) প্রার্থনা বা শুভেচ্ছা বোঝায়। এর indirect করতে reporting verb বদলে wish বা pray বসে, quotation চিহ্ন সরে that আসে, তারপর reported speech-এর subject, may-এর বদলে might এবং বাকি অংশ। তাই My friend wished that I might pass the pen to her শুদ্ধ। Prayed বা hoped অর্থ ও গঠনের দিক থেকে মেলে না।

q: Lisa said, "I must talk to the director about the project." (change the narration)
o: Lisa said that she had to talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she has to talk to the director about the project.
Lisa said that she had talk to the director about the project.
